description: One call for a domain (or URL): A/AAAA, NS, SOA, MX (incl. null MX), TXT, CAA, DNSSEC validation flag, parsed SPF (all-qualifier, includes, lookup estimate, verdict), DMARC (policy, sp, pct, rua), MTA-STS presence, site-verification tokens, and one HTTPS GET of / (status, final URL, HSTS, server), plus a plain-language issues list. Read live via DNS-over-HTTPS (Cloudflare 1.1.1.1, Google fallback). No WHOIS. Price: $0.003 USDC on Base per call, paid with x402 (MCP transport: an unpaid call returns the x402 PaymentRequired object; retry with params._meta["x402/payment"]). Same tool over HTTP: GET /api/domain-check.
name: domain_check
title: Domain DNS + mail-security + HTTPS check
